title: Pg_vectorsearch: An index that is faster than pgvector's IVFFlat and HNSW
title_zh: Pg_vectorsearch：一种比 pgvector 的 IVFFlat 和 HNSW 更快的索引

paragraphs.zh: PostgreSQL 的高性能向量搜索

paragraphs.en: A PostgreSQL extension for high-performance approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) search.
paragraphs.zh: 一个用于高性能近似最近邻（ANN）搜索的 PostgreSQL 扩展。

paragraphs.en: Status: alpha. Meant for testing, not production. Upgrading between prereleases may not be possible; plan to drop and recreate the extension and its indexes. See the changelog for known issues.
paragraphs.zh: 状态：alpha（早期测试版）。 仅用于测试，不适用于生产环境。 在预发布版本之间升级可能无法实现；请计划删除并重新创建该扩展及其索引。 已知问题请参见更新日志。

paragraphs.en: PRISM (Partitioned Routing Index for Similarity Matching) is a PostgreSQL-native index access method that is conceptually similar to pgvector 's IVFFlat, but it is built around state-of-the-art quantization, routing, and partitioning techniques. It is implemented in C for high performance and seamless integration with PostgreSQL.
paragraphs.zh: PRISM（Partitioned Routing Index for Similarity Matching，用于相似度匹配的分区路由索引）是一个 PostgreSQL 原生索引访问方法，在概念上类似于 pgvector 的 IVFFlat，但它建立在最先进的量化、路由和分区技术之上。 它用 C 语言实现，以获得高性能并与 PostgreSQL 无缝集成。

sents.en: PRISM (Partitioned Routing Index for Similarity Matching) is a PostgreSQL-native index access method that is conceptually similar to pgvector 's IVFFlat, but it is built around state-of-the-art quantization, routing, and partitioning techniques.
sents.zh: PRISM（Partitioned Routing Index for Similarity Matching，用于相似度匹配的分区路由索引）是一个 PostgreSQL 原生索引访问方法，在概念上类似于 pgvector 的 IVFFlat，但它建立在最先进的量化、路由和分区技术之上。

sents.en: It is implemented in C for high performance and seamless integration with PostgreSQL.
sents.zh: 它用 C 语言实现，以获得高性能并与 PostgreSQL 无缝集成。

paragraphs.en: The result: an index that is significantly faster than pgvector's IVFFlat and HNSW, for both querying and index building. In fact, compared to graph-based HNSW, PRISM is faster at equivalent recall on a 100-million-vector dataset, on an instance with a quarter of the memory.
paragraphs.zh: 结果是：无论是在查询还是索引构建方面，该索引都比 pgvector 的 IVFFlat 和 HNSW 快得多。 事实上，与基于图的 HNSW 相比，在同等召回率下，PRISM 在一个 1 亿向量数据集上，仅使用四分之一内存的实例上运行得更快。

sents.en: The result: an index that is significantly faster than pgvector's IVFFlat and HNSW, for both querying and index building.
sents.zh: 结果是：无论是在查询还是索引构建方面，该索引都比 pgvector 的 IVFFlat 和 HNSW 快得多。

sents.en: In fact, compared to graph-based HNSW, PRISM is faster at equivalent recall on a 100-million-vector dataset, on an instance with a quarter of the memory.
sents.zh: 事实上，与基于图的 HNSW 相比，在同等召回率下，PRISM 在一个 1 亿向量数据集上，仅使用四分之一内存的实例上运行得更快。

paragraphs.en: To achieve this performance, PRISM uses a hierarchical centroid tree to partition vectors into clusters, and relies on the PostgreSQL buffer cache to keep that tree warm in memory. Vectors are RaBitQ -quantized and stored in posting lists with a page layout optimized for SIMD distance computation. The RaBitQ encoding carries error bounds that let a search rule out vectors that cannot possibly be nearest neighbors, so far fewer of them need reranking against the full-precision vectors stored in the table.
paragraphs.zh: 为了实现这一性能，PRISM 使用分层质心树将向量划分为多个簇，并依赖 PostgreSQL 缓冲区缓存使该树在内存中保持“温热”状态。 向量经 RaBitQ 量化后存储在倒排列表（posting list）中，其页布局专为 SIMD 距离计算进行了优化。 RaBitQ 编码携带误差界，使搜索能够排除不可能是最近邻的向量，因此需要对表中存储的全精度向量进行重排序的向量数量大大减少。

sents.en: To achieve this performance, PRISM uses a hierarchical centroid tree to partition vectors into clusters, and relies on the PostgreSQL buffer cache to keep that tree warm in memory.
sents.zh: 为了实现这一性能，PRISM 使用分层质心树将向量划分为多个簇，并依赖 PostgreSQL 缓冲区缓存使该树在内存中保持“温热”状态。

sents.en: Vectors are RaBitQ -quantized and stored in posting lists with a page layout optimized for SIMD distance computation.
sents.zh: 向量经 RaBitQ 量化后存储在倒排列表（posting list）中，其页布局专为 SIMD 距离计算进行了优化。

sents.en: The RaBitQ encoding carries error bounds that let a search rule out vectors that cannot possibly be nearest neighbors, so far fewer of them need reranking against the full-precision vectors stored in the table.
sents.zh: RaBitQ 编码携带误差界，使搜索能够排除不可能是最近邻的向量，因此需要对表中存储的全精度向量进行重排序的向量数量大大减少。

paragraphs.en: Query Flow: 1. Traverse centroid tree to find nearest clusters (buffer cache) 2. Scan posting lists for candidates (buffer cache, async I/O) 3. RaBitQ two-stage filtering: estimate → error bound → rerank 4. Full-precision reranking from heap 5. Return k nearest neighbors For detailed architecture, see docs/architecture.md .
paragraphs.zh: 查询流程：1. 遍历质心树以找到最近的簇（缓冲区缓存）2. 扫描倒排列表以获取候选（缓冲区缓存、异步 I/O）3. RaBitQ 两阶段过滤：估计 → 误差界 → 重排序 4. 从堆中进行全精度重排序 5. 返回 k 个最近邻 有关详细架构，请参见 docs/architecture.md 。

paragraphs.en: Install the extension first; see Building .
paragraphs.zh: 请先安装扩展，参见「构建」（Building）。

paragraphs.en: There are two ways to use a PRISM index. Pick the one that matches where your vectors live:
paragraphs.zh: 使用 PRISM 索引有两种方式。 请根据你的向量所在的位置选择合适的一种：

sents.en: There are two ways to use a PRISM index.
sents.zh: 使用 PRISM 索引有两种方式。

sents.en: Pick the one that matches where your vectors live:
sents.zh: 请根据你的向量所在的位置选择合适的一种：

paragraphs.en: Both paths build the same index and use the same operators ( <-> , <#> , <=> ) and tuning knobs.
paragraphs.zh: 两条路径构建相同的索引，并使用相同的算子（ <-> 、 <#> 、 <=> ）和调优参数。

paragraphs.en: CREATE EXTENSION pg_vectorsearch; -- PLAIN keeps the vector inline. EXTERNAL (the default) toasts a value -- over ~2 kB, and rerank then pays an extra fetch the planner does not cost. CREATE TABLE items ( id serial PRIMARY KEY , embedding vec32( 3 ) STORAGE PLAIN ); -- Load first; the index is sized from the row count at CREATE INDEX. -- 500 rows is enough for the planner to use the index. INSERT INTO items (embedding) SELECT ARRAY[i:: real , (i % 7 ):: real , (i % 5 ):: real ]::vec32 FROM generate_series( 1 , 1000 ) i; -- For inner product or cosine, see Operator classes below. CREATE INDEX ON items USING prism (embedding vec32_l2_ops); -- 0 = auto (~0.95 recall). Raise for recall, lower for speed. SET prism . nprobe = 40 ; SELECT * FROM items ORDER BY embedding < - > ' [3,1,2] ' LIMIT 5 ; Use vec16 instead of vec32 to halve the space vectors take in the table, with the matching vec16_* operator classes .
paragraphs.zh: CREATE EXTENSION pg_vectorsearch; -- PLAIN 让向量保持内联存储。 EXTERNAL（默认值）会对超过约 2 kB 的值进行 TOAST 存储，此时 rerank 需要付出一次额外的读取开销，而规划器并不会把这部分计入成本。 CREATE TABLE items ( id serial PRIMARY KEY , embedding vec32( 3 ) STORAGE PLAIN ); -- 先加载数据；索引大小取决于 CREATE INDEX 时的行数。-- 500 行就足以让规划器使用该索引。 INSERT INTO items (embedding) SELECT ARRAY[i:: real , (i % 7 ):: real , (i % 5 ):: real ]::vec32 FROM generate_series( 1 , 1000 ) i; -- 关于内积或余弦距离，请参见下文的操作符类。 CREATE INDEX ON items USING prism (embedding vec32_l2_ops); -- 0 表示自动（召回率约 0.95）。 调大该值可提高召回率，调小该值可提升速度。 SET prism . nprobe = 40 ; SELECT * FROM items ORDER BY embedding < - > ' [3,1,2] ' LIMIT 5 ; 使用 vec16 代替 vec32 可以将向量在表中占用的空间减半，但需配合相应的 vec16_* 操作符类使用。

paragraphs.en: If you already have a table with pgvector's vector or halfvec columns, you can build a PRISM index on it directly. Nothing about the table or your queries needs to change. vec32 and vec16 are binary-compatible with pgvector's vector and halfvec but have different names, so the two extensions can be installed side by side, even in the same schema.
paragraphs.zh: 如果你已经有一个包含 pgvector 的 vector 或 halfvec 列的表，可以直接在其上构建 PRISM 索引。 表和你的查询都无需任何更改。vec32 和 vec16 与 pgvector 的 vector 和 halfvec 二进制兼容，只是名称不同，因此这两个扩展可以并行安装，甚至可以安装在同一个 schema 中。

sents.en: If you already have a table with pgvector's vector or halfvec columns, you can build a PRISM index on it directly.
sents.zh: 如果你已经有一个包含 pgvector 的 vector 或 halfvec 列的表，可以直接在其上构建 PRISM 索引。

sents.en: Nothing about the table or your queries needs to change. vec32 and vec16 are binary-compatible with pgvector's vector and halfvec but have different names, so the two extensions can be installed side by side, even in the same schema.
sents.zh: 表和你的查询都无需任何更改。vec32 和 vec16 与 pgvector 的 vector 和 halfvec 二进制兼容，只是名称不同，因此这两个扩展可以并行安装，甚至可以安装在同一个 schema 中。

paragraphs.en: -- The table you already have, included so the example runs on its own. CREATE EXTENSION vector; CREATE TABLE documents ( id bigserial PRIMARY KEY , body text , embedding vector( 384 ) ); CREATE INDEX documents_embedding_hnsw ON documents USING hnsw (embedding vector_l2_ops); -- Install pg_vectorsearch next to pgvector and build the index on the -- existing column. The column is not rewritten or copied. CREATE EXTENSION pg_vectorsearch; CREATE INDEX documents_embedding_prism ON documents USING prism (embedding vec32_l2_ops); -- Your queries keep working as before. PRISM is normally faster, so -- the planner should prefer it over the HNSW index while both exist. -- Verify with an EXPLAIN: EXPLAIN (COSTS OFF) SELECT id, body FROM documents ORDER BY embedding < - > ( SELECT embedding FROM documents WHERE id = 42 ) LIMIT 10 ; -- Limit -- InitPlan 1 -- -> Index Scan using documents_pkey on documents documents_1 -- Index Cond: (id = 42) -- -> Index Scan using documents_embedding_prism on documents -- Order By: (embedding <-> (InitPlan 1).col1) -- Once you are happy with it, drop the HNSW index. DROP INDEX documents_embedding_hnsw; Use the PRISM operator class for the same distance metric as your HNSW index.
paragraphs.zh: -- 你已有的表，包含它是为了让示例可以独立运行。 CREATE EXTENSION vector; CREATE TABLE documents ( id bigserial PRIMARY KEY , body text , embedding vector( 384 ) ); CREATE INDEX documents_embedding_hnsw ON documents USING hnsw (embedding vector_l2_ops); -- 在 pgvector 旁边安装 pg_vectorsearch，并在 -- 已有的列上构建索引。 该列不会被重写或复制。 CREATE EXTENSION pg_vectorsearch; CREATE INDEX documents_embedding_prism ON documents USING prism (embedding vec32_l2_ops); -- 你的查询会像以前一样正常工作。 PRISM 通常更快，因此 -- 在两者并存时，规划器应该会优先选择它而不是 HNSW 索引。 -- 用 EXPLAIN 验证： EXPLAIN (COSTS OFF) SELECT id, body FROM documents ORDER BY embedding < - > ( SELECT embedding FROM documents WHERE id = 42 ) LIMIT 10 ; -- 限制条数 -- InitPlan 1 -- -> Index Scan using documents_pkey on documents documents_1 -- Index Cond: (id = 42) -- -> Index Scan using documents_embedding_prism on documents -- Order By: (embedding <-> (InitPlan 1).col1) -- 确认满意后，删除 HNSW 索引。 DROP INDEX documents_embedding_hnsw; 为 PRISM 使用与你的 HNSW 索引相同的距离度量所对应的操作符类。

sents.zh: DROP INDEX documents_embedding_hnsw; 为 PRISM 使用与你的 HNSW 索引相同的距离度量所对应的操作符类。

paragraphs.en: Pick the operator class for your distance metric and column type. L2 is the default.
paragraphs.zh: 为你的距离度量和列类型选择操作符类。L2 是默认值。

paragraphs.en: When replacing an HNSW index, pgvector's vector_<metric>_ops maps to vec32_<metric>_ops and halfvec_<metric>_ops to vec16_<metric>_ops .
paragraphs.zh: 替换 HNSW 索引时，pgvector 的 vector_<metric>_ops 会映射到 vec32_<metric>_ops，halfvec_<metric>_ops 会映射到 vec16_<metric>_ops。

paragraphs.en: Defaults are tuned from large-scale benchmarks; most deployments only ever adjust prism.nprobe . See the tuning guide for every index parameter and GUC, their tradeoffs, and when changing them makes sense.
paragraphs.zh: 默认值基于大规模基准测试调优；大多数部署只需调整 prism.nprobe 。 有关所有索引参数和 GUC、它们的权衡以及何时更改它们才有意义，请参阅调优指南。

paragraphs.en: An insert appends to whichever posting list its vector routes to, so lists grow as rows arrive and never split on their own. Besides REINDEX , the prism_rebalance procedure splits oversized lists in place. See the maintenance guide for how it works and its current limitations.
paragraphs.zh: 插入操作会把向量追加到它所路由到的倒排列表中，因此列表随着行的到来而增长，且自身从不分裂。 除了 REINDEX 之外，prism_rebalance 过程会就地拆分过大的列表。 有关其工作原理及当前限制，请参阅维护指南。

paragraphs.en: # Release build meson setup builddir --buildtype=release # Build and install to PostgreSQL meson install -C builddir See the development guide for build options.
paragraphs.zh:
# 发布版本构建
meson setup builddir --buildtype=release

# 构建并安装到 PostgreSQL
meson install -C builddir
